title: Tool Abnormalities
description:
Not every Abnormality must be contained in a Containment Unit.

Those classified as "Tool Abnormalities" are manifested as mundane looking objects, and they can be purchased from the Moonlit Company for internal study.

Do not let the fact that these need no containing lure you into a false sense of security. Tool Abnormalities are often useful, but may have adverse effects. 

Careful monitoring and usage of Tool Abnormalities is profitable and recommended.
